```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** U06_2_Lab_Test_and_Reporting

**Target Application:** Virtual Pharmacy System

**Test Objective:** To verify the functionality and features of lab tests, reports, and prescription setting.

**Test Scope:**
- Lab Incharge can perform lab tests and update reports (offline & online) and set the flag in prescription.
- Chemist can deliver medicine to the concerned patient (offline) and set the flag in prescription.
- Admin and Patient can view the invoice and reports for the appointment.

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Requirement ID | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Lab Incharge can perform lab tests | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Positive | Lab Incharge is logged in | Lab test details | Perform lab test, update report, set prescription flag | Report updated, prescription flag set |
| TC-002 | Chemist can deliver medicine | VIRTUA-2.3-14 | Positive | Chemist is logged in, patient information available | Patient ID, medicine details | Deliver medicine, set prescription flag | Medicine delivered, prescription flag set |
| TC-003 | Admin can view invoice and reports | UC-14 | Positive | Admin is logged in, appointment details available | Appointment ID | View invoice and reports | Invoice and reports displayed |
| TC-004 | Offline report update | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Negative | Offline mode enabled | Lab test details | Attempt to update report | Error message indicating offline mode |
| TC-005 | Invalid prescription flag setting | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Negative | Lab Incharge is logged in | Invalid prescription flag value | Set prescription flag with invalid value | Error message indicating invalid value |
| TC-006 | Boundary check for report update date | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Boundary | Lab Incharge is logged in | Report date at maximum boundary | Update report with date at maximum boundary | Report updated successfully |
| TC-007 | Groundedness of invoice amount | UC-14 | Groundedness | Invoice generated | Invoice amount | Verify invoice amount matches calculated amount | Invoice amount matches calculated amount |

```
